“LOOKING DOWN THE ROAD HOW THEY MIGHT PROJECT INTO OUR PROGRAM, AND HOW THEY MIGHT FIT”

New episode of the ATT Podcast, featuring Martin Stone, Head Coach for the University of Notre Dame Women’s Rowing program!

Leading @ndrowing for over two decades, Coach Stone shares incredible insights into coaching and college recruiting as we dive into…

*The emphasis on balance as a Division 1 rower who aspires to have both a rigorous academic load, and the demands of college rowing.

*College recruiting, and the athletic characteristics and intangible qualities that coaches look for in aspiring college rowers.

*Coach Stone’s input on how scholarships impact the college process, and whether roster limitations will have an effect on recruiting.

For High School Rowers and Parents who are looking for an in-depth understanding of rowing at the Division 1 level, I absolutely encourage you to give this a listen.

And please SHARE this clip for more athletes to benefit from!
